# current logos — the single source

**Every render loads the mark from this folder.** If you are about to write a render that
reads its geometry from anywhere else, stop and move the asset here first.

Drop new logos straight into this folder. Multiple exports of the same mark are fine —
name them `bonk-<lockup>[-<variant>].svg` so the newest is obvious at a glance.

---

## Canonical

**`bonk-mark.js`** — `window.BONK_MARK` (and `BONK_MARK_V2`, same object). Generated by
`../extract_current_mark.py` from `bonk-new-logo-black-svg.svg`, using the **exact vector
data**, not a trace. `627 × 262`, aspect `2.3931`, 6 glyphs, origin `{687, 869}`.

Verified against the asset itself: raw mask-diff IoU `0.9777`, which rises to `0.999161`
at 1 px tolerance and **`1.000000` at 2 px** — every differing pixel is sub-pixel edge
alignment, so the shape is identical.

The `d` is in the asset's own 2000×2000 space. **A render must subtract `MARK.origin`** or
the whole mark draws shifted by `origin × scale`. The motion system does this in two places
(`makePanel` *and* `specimen`'s per-cell marks).

## Superseded — do not use in new work

These still exist because old renders and old GIFs reference them. Nothing was deleted.

| Asset | What it is | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `../blueprint/public/wordmark-paths.js` | **a different mark** — `302.1 × 257.0`, aspect `1.1755`, `letterCount 4` | **superseded** |
| `../blueprint/public/bonk-mark-v2.js` | a *trace* of the current logo (`627 × 262`), one control point off by 0.22 units (0.08%) | superseded by `bonk-mark.js` |
| `../blueprint/public/bonk-mark-font.js` | the `?mark=font` register | **superseded** |
| `../bonk-mark-sup.js` | the superscript mark measured from the 03:04 upload | **superseded** |
| `../bonk-wordmark.svg`, `../bonk-wordmark-gradient.svg` | earlier exports | **superseded** |

`wordmark-paths.js` is not an older version of the current logo — it is a different drawing.
Mask-diff IoU against the current mark: **0.342**. It was what `bonk-motion-system-v3.html`
was loading until the swap, which is exactly the failure this folder exists to prevent.

Two exports of the same mark should never be assumed identical. A newer export differed
from the older one by `+14.666` in x on one glyph, `+20.633` on another, and `+15.5` in y
on all of them — re-laid-out horizontally and padded vertically, with the aspect moving
`3.2844 → 3.1162`. A rescale would have been wrong by 5%.

## Type

Text uses **Bonk**, the brand's own face — never a borrowed mono.

- Served from `../blueprint/public/fonts/Bonk-VF.woff2` (133 KB, woff2) with
  `Bonk-VF.ttf` (474 KB) behind it.
- Variable: `wght 300–700`, `slnt −10–0`. Declared as a weight **range**
  (`font-weight: 300 700`) so one file serves both 400 and 600.
- 665 glyphs in the cmap; verified 0 missing across the 75-character label charset.
- The full family (Regular, Bold, Light, Italic, BonkDisplay-Bold, BonkHeadline-Bold)
  is served alongside it for work that needs a specific cut.

**Still on IBM Plex Mono, not yet migrated:** `blueprint/public/bonk-blueprint{,-v2,-v3-sup}.html`,
`motion-system/bonk-motion-system{,-v2}.html`, `blurreveal/public/*`, `logo/bonk-sup.html`.

## Verifying a font actually painted

A `@font-face` that fails to load does **not** error — it falls back and looks plausible.
`document.fonts.check()` can also report true for a face that never rendered a glyph. The
only decisive test is to draw the same string twice, once with the font and once with the
fallback, and compare the pixels; identical output means it never loaded. Measured for
Bonk: 6,062 ink px vs 5,543 for the fallback, a **9.4% difference**.
